name: Membership Lanyard
flavor: +1 PER. Worn on the neck. Opens doors and resentment.

name: Wedding Ring
flavor: +1 Dadism power. A ring. A reminder. A power source.

name: Reading Glasses on a Chain
flavor: On your face. ON YOUR FACE.

name: The Studfinder of Prophecy
flavor: +1 PER. Vibrates when hidden things are nearby — traps, secrets, structural dishonesty. Feared by drywall demons. Do not confuse with the weapon.

name: Digital Watch (Still Has Time)
flavor: +1 ATK, +1 WIS. Set in 2009. Still correct twice daily. He never reset it for daylight savings. He is at peace with this.

name: Keychain (45 Keys)
flavor: +1 PER, +1 slot. He knows what four of them go to. Possibly five. The rest are load-bearing.

name: Fortune Cookie (Unread)
flavor: +2 Dadism power. Carried since the restaurant in 2019. He will read it when the moment is right.

name: Lucky Penny (Heads Up)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 ATK. Found in a 2014 parking lot. Never spent. A good omen. The statistics support this.

name: Clip-On Suspenders
flavor: +2 DEF. Structural redundancy. Belt AND suspenders. Only one is necessary. He uses both. He will not apologize.

name: Motivational Wristband
flavor: +1 ATK, +1 Dadism power. Says 'PUSH HARDER' in all caps. He agrees with this sentiment.

name: Lucky Fishing Lure
flavor: +2 PER. Attached to the hat band. Has never caught a fish. The intent has always been there.

name: Expired Conference Badge
flavor: +1 WIS, +1 PER. From TechConnect 2017. He still knows someone there. Probably.

name: Ever-Present Toothpick
flavor: +1 ATK, +1 PER. Migrates from corner to corner of the mouth. Sees all. Says little. Has been the same toothpick for a concerning duration.

name: Old Dog Tags (Not Military)
flavor: +1 DEF, +1 Dadism power. From a 5K in 2011. He kept them. They confer no rank. They confer resolve.

name: Bottle-Opener Ring
flavor: +1 ATK, +1 DEF. Solves exactly one problem, perfectly, forever. The most reliable tool he owns.

name: One Working Earbud
flavor: +1 WIS, +1 PER. The left one died in 2020. The right one carries the entire podcast. He hears half the world and judges all of it.
